steps.name: Wolf's Lair Shrine
steps.wikiText: Wolf's Lair Shrine is a point of interest within Graupel Kohn. In the back of this chilly cave is found a Spirits of the Wild shrine dedicated to Wolf. A norn shaman resides here with his pack of wolves.

steps.name: Skovtrolde Hearthstead
steps.wikiText: Skovtrolde Hearthstead is a point of interest within Graupel Kohn. This is one of the many norn lodges in Dredgehaunt Cliffs. A sylvari named Cydwenn is taking care of all the children around the place.

steps.name: Graupel Kohn
steps.wikiText: Graupel Kohn is an area in the northern Dredgehaunt Cliffs. Many steadings can be found in the area as well as the ruins of a jotun settlement which is currently being studied by the Durmand Priory.

steps.name: Graupel Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Graupel Kohn is an area in the northern Dredgehaunt Cliffs. Many steadings can be found in the area as well as the ruins of a jotun settlement which is currently being studied by the Durmand Priory.

steps.name: Brandalf's Steading
steps.wikiText: Brandalf's Steading[sic] is a point of interest within Graupel Kohn. This is one of the many norn lodges in Dredgehaunt Cliffs. Brandulf and his sister Myr reside here and operate this inn and tavern.

steps.name: Talecrafting Steading
steps.wikiText: Talecrafting Steading is a point of interest within Mountain's Tail. This corrupted norn lodge is home to a group of Sons of Svanir led by their shaman.

steps.name: Help the grawl stave off Svanir attacks.
steps.wikiText: Fight Svanir, destroy their corrupted turrets and ice containers, and help wounded grawl.

steps.name: Mountain's Tail Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Mountain's Tail is an area in the northeast of the Dredgehaunt Cliffs. A Sons of Svanir steading found there is trying to destroy the friendly grawl tribe living in Ulukk's Hunger.

steps.name: Assist the skritt of Ratatosk.
steps.wikiText: Destroy spiders and webs, free skritt from cocoons, and keep skritt in fighting shape.

steps.name: Nottowr Fault Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Ratatosk is a large cave system in the northeast of Dredgehaunt Cliffs. It holds a sizeable skritt scratch. Aside from the skritt there are many hostile Cave Spiders present in the caves.

steps.name: Shiniest Skritt Treasure
steps.wikiText: The Shiniest Skritt Treasure is a hero challenge located in Ratatosk, a skritt outpost in Dredgehaunt Cliffs. To gain the hero point, one must commune with the treasure. It is usually guarded by a Veteran Cave Spider and its minions.

steps.name: The Speaking Place
steps.wikiText: The Speaking Place is a point of interest within Ratatosk. Deep inside this dark skritt cave system rests a circular podium beneath a typical skritt structure. A colony of cave spiders occupies this location.

steps.name: Wide Expanse Waypoint
steps.wikiText: The Wide Expanse is an area in the east of Dredgehaunt Cliffs. It is home to a large tribe of jotun.

steps.name: Raven's Wing Shrine
steps.wikiText: Raven's Wing Shrine is a point of interest within The Wide Expanse. Set against the raw cliff face sits this Spirits of the Wild shrine dedicated to Raven. Many woodland creatures gather at this pastoral setting.

steps.name: Preserved Footprint
steps.wikiText: A Preserved Footprint can be found inside The Wide Expanse of Dredgehaunt Cliffs. Interacting with it triggers the Defeat the ancient jotun spirits hero challenge.

steps.name: Kenning Testing Ground Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Theign Spiritwalk is an area located in the center of Dredgehaunt Cliffs. An ancient jotun citadel can be found there as well as a Durmand Priory camp studying the jotun from up-close.

steps.name: Theign Kenning
steps.wikiText: Theign Kenning is a point of interest within Theign Spiritwalk. Through this narrow pass lies a guarded circle of stones surrounding the Jotun Holy Site. A spirit elder remains to guard this important jotun site.

steps.name: Jotun Holy Site
steps.wikiText: Jotun Holy Site is a site where the presence of the elder jotun spirits can be felt. Communing with it awards the player one hero point.

steps.name: Bergtrolde
steps.wikiText: Bergtrolde is a point of interest within Graupel Kohn. This is one of the many norn lodges in Dredgehaunt Cliffs. This inn is run by Bergtrolde Icetreader who lives here with her two children.

steps.name: Havfrue Basin Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Graupel Kohn is an area in the northern Dredgehaunt Cliffs. Many steadings can be found in the area as well as the ruins of a jotun settlement which is currently being studied by the Durmand Priory.

steps.name: Travelen's Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Snowslide Ravine is an area in the northwest of Dredgehaunt Cliffs. A norn steading has been built here, which has become the target of a nearby group of Sons of Svanir.

steps.name: Travelen's Steading
steps.wikiText: Travelen's Steading is a point of interest within Snowslide Ravine. This is one of many norn lodges found throughout Dredgehaunt Cliffs. This busy tavern is run by Travelen and welcomes all travelers to his establishment.

steps.name: Defend Travelen's Steading against Svanir attacks.
steps.wikiText: Build snowmen, stop troublemakers, and keep the lodge cozy and safe.

steps.name: Wyrmblood Lake
steps.wikiText: Across the bridge from the Leopard's Snarl Shrine. Jump up from the roof of Travelen's Steading from the East.

steps.name: Falooaloo
steps.wikiText: Falooaloo is a point of interest within Wyrmblood Lake. This quaggan village found under the ice sheet is currently preparing their defense against an incoming icebrood attack.

steps.name: Leopard's Snarl Shrine
steps.wikiText: Leopard's Snarl Shrine is a point of interest within Wyrmblood Lake. At the back of this small plateau sits a Spirits of the Wild shrine dedicated to Snow Leopard. This location is guarded by a flock of eagle griffons.

steps.name: Protect the Snow Leopard shrine from the Svanir.
steps.wikiText: Kill Sons of Svanir, and tear down their territory markers and Dragon totems.

steps.name: Wyrmblood Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Kolkorensburg is a large cave system in the northwestern Dredgehaunt Cliffs. It is home to a friendly skritt scratch. Aside from them, there are many hostile Phantom Imps present in the caves which have come through a portal.

steps.name: Ghost Stones
steps.wikiText: Ghost Stones is a Point of Interest within Kolkorensburg. These ancient jotun runestones seem to be a portal to the Mists.

steps.name: Help Antal the Patient impress the skritt in Kolkorensburg.
steps.wikiText: Make the skritt happy by entertaining them, returning lost treasures, and killing threats to their cave.

steps.name: Hessdallen Kenning Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Troll's Teeth is a location near the center of Dredgehaunt Cliffs. The ruins of a former jotun citadel as well as a Durmand Priory camp helping the skritt of Kolkorensburg can be found here.

steps.name: Troll's Teeth
steps.wikiText: Troll's Teeth is a location near the center of Dredgehaunt Cliffs. The ruins of a former jotun citadel as well as a Durmand Priory camp helping the skritt of Kolkorensburg can be found here.

steps.name: Landslide Lee
steps.wikiText: Landslide Lee is a point of interest within Troll's Teeth. A small group of scholars have established a campsite here from where they carry out their research in the surrounding area.

steps.name: Bear's Jaws Shrine
steps.wikiText: Bear's Jaws Shrine is a point of interest in Toran Hollow. Set against the mountain side at the fork of the road sits a Spirits of the Wild shrine dedicated to Bear.

steps.name: Toran Hollow Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Toran Hollow is an area in the west of Dredgehaunt Cliffs. A small tribe of hostile grawl can be found here. They often raid the nearby shrine dedicated to the Spirit Bear.

steps.name: Toran Hollow
steps.wikiText: Near the Waypoint, there is a portal connecting Dredgehaunt Cliffs to Lornar's Pass. Face that portal, the way up to the Vista is to your left. Follow the left path for a little and jump up and over the portal to get to the vista.

steps.name: Leaning Grade
steps.wikiText: Leaning Grade is a point of interest in Steelbrachen. This group of monolithic stones is an ancient ruin. Durmand Priory scholars make pilgrimages here to investigate this site.

steps.name: Shelter Pointe
steps.wikiText: Shelter Pointe is a point of interest in Steelbrachen. A top this small rise a group of Durmand Priory researchers have established a base camp.

steps.name: Assist Daphne in halting the encroaching corruption.
steps.wikiText: Kill corrupted elementals, defeat Sons of Svanir, and thwart their plans.

steps.name: Kakkilak
steps.wikiText: Kakkilak can be found within Dissun's Mine. The entrance to the cave complex is on the snowy plain in Steelbrachen, not against the mountainside. Interact with her for the hero challenge.

steps.name: Esjudare Scratch
steps.wikiText: Esjudare Scratch is a point of interest within Dissun's Mine. Inside this cave system is a skritt scratch and a small population of skritts. They live in an almost constant struggle against the dredge.

steps.name: Steelbrachen Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Steelbrachen is an area in west of Dredgehaunt Cliffs. The Durmand Priory has established a camp here in order to study nearby jotun ruins. There is also a cave housing a group of Sons of Svanir.

steps.name: Tomb of Blackpowder
steps.wikiText: Tomb of Blackpowder is a point of interest in Kapellenburg. This ancient dwarven tomb is found inside the dredge held caves. The door can be opened using a Dwarven Key which starts an event.

steps.name: Tribulation Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Tribulation Rift is a location in the southwest of Dredgehaunt Cliffs. This large and well-defended pit leads to the dredge capital of Sorrow's Embrace.

steps.name: Help Magister Kathryn wound dredge forces.
steps.wikiText: Return unexploded fire bombs to Priory drop boxes, and block mortar shots with Priory shield generators.

steps.name: Sorrow's Embrace Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Tribulation Rift is a location in the southwest of Dredgehaunt Cliffs. This large and well-defended pit leads to the dredge capital of Sorrow's Embrace.

steps.name: Tomb of Morlog
steps.wikiText: The Tomb of Morlog is a point of interest within Tribulation Rift. Located in the back of this dredge controlled area is a sealed door leading to the tomb of Morlog. This door cannot be opened.

steps.name: Tribulation Rift Viewpoint
steps.wikiText: This Vista is reached via the Tribulation Rift Jump Puzzle

steps.name: Help Explorer Brokkar sabotage dredge munitions.
steps.wikiText: Clear dredge and turrets from the area, use cannonballs to open armory doors, and sabotage munitions stocks.

steps.name: Frostland Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Frostland Melt is an area in the center of the southernmost portion of Dredgehaunt Cliffs.

steps.name: Mantelet Refuge
steps.wikiText: Mantelet Refuge is a point of interest in Frostland Melt. It is an old monastery used primarily as a Durmand Priory encampment for their operations in the mountains. It is under siege regularly by the dredge.

steps.name: Frostland Melt
steps.wikiText: Start from Mantelet Refuge in Frostland Melt, head to the southern part of the fort and exit through the back door.

steps.name: Firebase Molek
steps.wikiText: Firebase Molek is a point of interest within Frostland Melt. This walled fortress is fought over and changes hands often between human and dredge forces as part of the In Pursuit of Knowledge meta event.

steps.name: Fridgardr Lodge
steps.wikiText: Fridgardr Lodge is a point of interest within The Grey Road. This walled fortress is fought over and changes hands often between human and dredge forces as part of the In Pursuit of Knowledge meta event.

steps.name: Grey Road Waypoint
steps.wikiText: The Grey Road is an area in the southeast of Dredgehaunt Cliffs. Hostile dredge often set ambushes for people traveling on this road.

steps.name: Tomb of Stoneskin
steps.wikiText: The Tomb of Stoneskin is a point of interest within Dostoev Sky Peak. This ancient Dwarven Tomb is found inside the caves held by the dredge. The door can be opened using a Dwarven Key which starts an event.

steps.name: Vpered Drill
steps.wikiText: Vpered Drill is a point of interest within Dostoev Sky Peak. Inside the center of this vast cave system is a large dredge excavator. This location contains many levels to explore and a vast system of defended catwalks.

steps.name: Dostoev Sky Peak
steps.wikiText: Dostoev Sky Peak is a massive dredge mine containing dwarven artifacts located in the center of Dredgehaunt Cliffs.

steps.name: Foreman's Gear
steps.wikiText: Foreman's Gear can be found on the ground at Dostoev Sky Peak. Interacting with it spawns the foreman and his crew.

steps.name: Help the Priory thwart dredge excavation in Dostoev Sky Peak.
steps.wikiText: Sabotage weapon caches, slay dredge miners, and recover ore for research.

steps.name: Seven Pines Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Nakrojos Pass is an area in east of Dredgehaunt Cliffs. It is home to a lone hunter as well as a Durmand Priory camp studying dredge blueprints.

steps.name: Granite Citadel Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Spearhead Bane is an area in the southeast of Dredgehaunt Cliffs. It holds the remains of the Granite Citadel, an ancient dwarven stronghold. The Durmand Priory are conducting research on the tombstones there.

steps.name: Help Arcanist Vance study dwarven relics at Granite Citadel.
steps.wikiText: Decipher dwarven headstones, and protect Priory researchers.

steps.name: Help Magister Roslin infiltrate Black Earth Mine.
steps.wikiText: Rescue Priory researchers, defuse dredge mines, and destroy reinforcement tubes.

steps.name: Dociu Waypoint
steps.wikiText: The Grey Road is an area in the southeast of Dredgehaunt Cliffs. Hostile dredge often set ambushes for people traveling on this road.

steps.name: Blackearth Coal Mine
steps.wikiText: Start from Mantelet Refuge in Frostland Melt, head to the southern part of the fort and exit through the back door. Beware of Trolls on the way. There may be a Veteran Troll and a rich gold vein as you make your way to the Vista.

steps.name: Dwarven Relic
steps.wikiText: A Dwarven Relic in the Dociu Excavation in the Dredgehaunt Cliffs. It is reached by walking through the dredge tunnels in the southeast corner of the map. It is guarded by a Veteran Dredge.
